name: @jtag-commands/plasticity/compact
description: Physically remove pruned heads from a model's safetensors. Reads gate_gradients.json from adapter directory, computes which heads to prune, then slices Q/K/V/O projection weights to remove dead heads. Produces a smaller model with fewer parameters. Handles both single-file and multi-shard models.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
